scope_notes: Only public SDK grip edits and geometry queries were inspected in an empty owned Rhino document on private Xvfb.
Six recipes retain before, edited and fully restored snapshots: mixed Mirror, triangle line/point, quad edge/line/point.
Kernel replays compare ordered vertices/faces/colors, topology locations and complete edge uses, polygon normals, area and closest points at 1e-12.
Native topology omits collapsed sides and keeps duplicate remaining uses by the same face, including incidence [0,1,1].
Collinear distinct-corner faces are Mesh.IsValid in Rhino; strict generation validity is a separate kernel policy.
RhinoCommon reports Origin for zero-area mass centroid; our area property retains zero area but explicitly rejects undefined centroid.
3DM round trips, n-gon retention, extreme/subnormal closest queries, display in four views/three modes, and STL atomic rejection are independent implementation checks.
Native archive interoperability, all edits of invalid meshes, repeated raw indices, nonplanar collapses, snapping, native preview/performance equivalence and full parity are unproven.
